tools.name: sparkle-strapper-20261012.json
tools.description: Add reviewed sparkle templates with separate hand and foot controls, then offer a continuous RGB option alongside manual hue. Copies controller, menu and parameter assets before editing them, and rejects incomplete prior installs that need repair.
tools.command_template: Install the reviewed editor source set described in docs/avatar-effects-editor-tools-20261012.md; then open Tools/Unity Unicorn/sparkle-strapper.
requirements: Unity 2022.3 with the intended avatar project and its legitimately acquired asset dependencies.
Review the source and keep a recoverable project baseline before applying changes.
limitations: Editor source preview; standalone compilation is not Unity or VRChat runtime verification.
Private learned templates, third-party assets and actual use records are not bundled.
